Backend/IaC release: the 3 Function Apps, portal (frontend + backend), and
Bicep/deploy scripts. Cloud Imaging Client and Media Builder ship from their own
release streams (tags `mse-ci-client-v*` / `mse-ci-mediabuilder-v*`).

### New role: Operator

This release adds the `CloudImaging.Operator` user role: OS, boot and recovery images,
Locations, Wi-Fi networks, Autopilot decisions and every report, without Branding, Configuration
or the boot media certificate. Existing roles and access are unchanged until someone is assigned
the new role.

**Administrators of existing tenants**: add `CloudImaging.Operator` to the **Cloud Imaging
Portal** and **Cloud Imaging Media Builder** app registrations, assign it, and have assigned users
sign out and back in. Do not change, remove or re-create any existing role or assignment. Follow
[Add the Operator role](https://github.com/MSEndpointMgr/CloudImaging/blob/main/docs/upgrade-instructions.md#add-the-operator-role)
in the upgrade instructions, and upgrade Media Builder to `mse-ci-mediabuilder-v1.1.0` as well.

Reports session data (`GET /api/session-history`) now refuses Technician tokens called directly.
The Portal never showed Reports to Technicians, and their Dashboard is unchanged.

### Setup profiles

A new **Imaging** > **Setup Profiles** page: registry values, PowerShell scripts and an optional
answer file applied to devices before Windows starts, targeted by the location on the USB media.
Scripts run in WinPE right after the image is applied, or during Windows setup before OOBE. The
deployment timeline gains an optional **Prepare setup** step that shows what was written and run.
Every save is a version that can be viewed and restored.

- **Roles**: Operators and Administrators create, edit, duplicate, delete and restore profiles,
  scripts and answer files included. Technicians view them read-only. Administrators set how many
  versions are kept (**Configuration** > **Miscellaneous**, default 25).
- **Infrastructure**: redeploy the Template Spec to add the `setup-profiles` blob container.
  Imaging Core creates its new tables itself. No data migration.
- **Upgrade order**: backend, then Media Builder `mse-ci-mediabuilder-v1.1.0`, then new boot
  images with Client `mse-ci-client-v1.1.0` on updated USB media. Devices on older boot images
  image without their profile, and the timeline shows Prepare setup as Not run. Follow
  [Turn on setup profiles](https://github.com/MSEndpointMgr/CloudImaging/blob/main/docs/upgrade-instructions.md#turn-on-setup-profiles).

See [Setup profiles](https://github.com/MSEndpointMgr/CloudImaging/blob/main/docs/setup-profiles.md).
